findings.quoted_text: 12.2 Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, subject to payment of fees for Services properly performed through the effective termination date. Contractor may terminate only for Client's material breach under Section 12.1.

12.2 Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, subject to payment of fees for Services properly performed through the effective termination date. Contractor may terminate only for Client's material breach under Section 12.1.
findings.explanation: Only the client has the right to terminate the contract without cause, while you cannot. Because work properly performed is paid, this is a low-severity asymmetry.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 20 days' written notice to the other party.
